$comment: Index of every catalog entry. Paths are relative to this folder; an anchor (#...) points at a section of a shared file. status: ready = usable now, planned = listed but not built yet.

style.name: Soft 3D
style.summary: Rounded toy-like 3D shapes with soft light, like clay figures.

style.name: 90s low poly
style.summary: Faceted low-polygon 3D with flat shading and a retro game feel.

style.name: Flat cartoon
style.summary: Bold flat shapes, thick outlines and bright colours.

style.name: Line art
style.summary: Clean single-weight lines on a plain background, drawn as you watch.

style.name: Ink silhouette
style.summary: Black silhouettes against a coloured sky, high contrast and moody.

style.name: Chalkboard
style.summary: Chalk drawings and handwriting on a dark board.

style.name: Paper cut-out
style.summary: Layered paper shapes with soft shadows, like a stop-motion collage.

style.name: Vintage comic
style.summary: Halftone dots, ink outlines and panels from old comic books.

style.name: 16-bit pixel art
style.summary: Chunky pixels and limited palettes from 16-bit consoles.

style.name: Neon synthwave
style.summary: Glowing neon lines on a dark grid under an 80s sunset.

style.name: Watercolour
style.summary: Soft washes of paint with visible paper texture.

style.name: Kinetic typography
style.summary: The words are the visuals: big type that moves with the voice.

script.name: Build it
script.summary: Something is built step by step, from nothing to finished.

script.name: Top N countdown
script.summary: A ranked list that counts down to number one.

script.name: Myth or fact
script.summary: A popular belief is stated, then confirmed or busted.

script.name: What if
script.summary: A hypothetical scenario followed to its consequences.

script.name: Story in 60 seconds
script.summary: A real event told as a compact story with a beginning, middle and end.

script.name: Surprising answer
script.summary: A simple question whose real answer is unexpected.

script.name: How it works
script.summary: An everyday thing explained from the inside.

script.name: X vs Y
script.summary: Two things compared point by point, with a verdict.

script.name: Did you know
script.summary: A quick chain of related facts, each stranger than the last.

script.name: Mini story
script.summary: A short fictional story with a twist, often starring the mascot.

hook.name: Shocking question
hook.summary: Open with a question the viewer can't answer but wants to.

hook.name: Absurd number
hook.summary: Open with a number so big or so small it sounds wrong.

hook.name: You're doing it wrong
hook.summary: Tell the viewer that something they do every day is wrong.

hook.name: Impossible image
hook.summary: Open on a picture that looks like it can't be real.

hook.name: Unfinished sentence
hook.summary: Start a sentence and finish it only at the end.

hook.name: Bold claim
hook.summary: Open with a strong statement, then prove it.

hook.name: Countdown tease
hook.summary: Promise that the last item is the best one.

hook.name: POV
hook.summary: Put the viewer inside the situation: "POV: you are...".

hook.name: Nobody talks about this
hook.summary: Frame the topic as overlooked or hidden.

hook.name: Before/after flash
hook.summary: Flash the finished result first, then go back to the start.

hook.name: Insider secret
hook.summary: Share what people in the field know and others don't.

hook.name: Challenge
hook.summary: Dare the viewer to guess, spot or try something.

hook.name: Start at the climax
hook.summary: Open on the most dramatic moment, then rewind.

hook.name: Relatable pain
hook.summary: Name a small frustration everyone has felt.

voice.name: Calm documentary
voice.summary: Slow, low and clear, like a nature documentary.

voice.name: Energetic
voice.summary: Fast and upbeat, with weight on every key word.

voice.name: Storyteller
voice.summary: Warm, with pauses that build suspense.

voice.name: Whisper
voice.summary: Quiet and close, for mysteries and calm content.

voice.name: Deadpan
voice.summary: Flat and dry, so the humour lands on the pause.

voice.name: Warm friendly
voice.summary: Like a friend explaining something over coffee.

voice.name: News anchor
voice.summary: Crisp and authoritative, like breaking news.

voice.name: None (text only)
voice.summary: No voice: captions and music carry the video.

captions.name: Word-by-word karaoke
captions.summary: Each word lights up as it is spoken.

captions.name: Bold centre
captions.summary: Short phrases in large type at the centre of the screen.

captions.name: Typewriter
captions.summary: Letters appear one at a time, as if being typed.

captions.name: Minimal lower third
captions.summary: Small, quiet subtitles near the bottom.

captions.name: Outline pop
captions.summary: Outlined words that pop in with a bounce.

captions.name: Highlight keyword
captions.summary: Full lines with the key word in a highlight colour.

music.name: Suspense
music.summary: Slow tension that builds under the voice.

music.name: Epic
music.summary: Big drums and strings for dramatic moments.

music.name: Lo-fi
music.summary: Relaxed beats for calm, cosy content.

music.name: Upbeat
music.summary: Bright and bouncy, keeps the pace high.

music.name: Playful
music.summary: Light and silly, for cartoons and animals.

music.name: Emotional
music.summary: Soft piano and strings for moving stories.

music.name: Mystery
music.summary: Strange, sparse sounds for unexplained things.

music.name: None
music.summary: No music: voice only, or a trending sound added when posting.

ending.name: Seamless loop
ending.summary: The last line flows back into the first, so the video replays.

ending.name: Comment question
ending.summary: Ask the viewer a question to answer in the comments.

ending.name: Follow for part 2
ending.summary: Promise a continuation in the next video.

ending.name: Punchline
ending.summary: End on a short, funny or surprising line.

ending.name: Callback to the hook
ending.summary: Answer or echo the opening line.

duration.name: 15 seconds
duration.summary: One fact, one punch. Best for loops.

duration.name: 30 seconds
duration.summary: The default: a hook, three beats and an ending.

duration.name: 45 seconds
duration.summary: Room for a short story or a top 5.
